selector.rationale: Microcephaly, marked enlargement of both lateral ventricles, and severe thinning of the frontal, parietal, and occipital lobes support Hydranencephaly

rejected.label: Fetal akinesia deformation sequence
rejected.why: Lack of specific evidence for fetal akinesia

rejected.label: Leber congenital amaurosis
rejected.why: Mild optic nerve pallor and suspected peripapillary double-ring sign are not decisive findings

rejected.label: Fetal growth restriction
rejected.why: Birth weight is not significantly low for gestational age

rejected.label: Cerebral dysgenesis
rejected.why: Not specific enough to explain the combination of microcephaly and ventricular enlargement

rejected.label: Hydrocephalus
rejected.why: While ventricular enlargement is present, Hydranencephaly better explains the combination of findings
